name: Caprese Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: about ¾ the weight of Mozzarella cheese as the tomato, sliced
Italian seasoning or oregano and pepper (optional)

steps: Cut the tomato into about 5 slices.
Put a slice of mozzarella cheese on top of each tomato slice.
Cut a horizontal slit halfway through each slice.
Put a basil leaf on top of each one.
Drizzle some vinegar and olive oil on top. Do not mix the vinegar and olive oil.

culture.text: Caprese salad is a delicious Italian dish made with tomato and mozzarella cheese. It is quite simple but tastes great and looks attractive.
